description_en: Cancels the comment ban on a specific user in a room
description_zh: 调用CancelBanComment接口，取消对房间内某特定用户的禁言
kebab_example: aliyun imp cancel-ban-comment --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id as0000hs --ban-comment-user er0000h --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelBanComment

parameters.description_en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. It contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
parameters.help_en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. It contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call the CreateRoom operation.
parameters.description_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call the CreateRoom operation
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.description_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the cancel comment ban operation.
parameters.description_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了取消禁言的操作。
parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the cancel comment ban operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了取消禁言的操作
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description_en: The user ID of the user whose comment ban is to be canceled.
parameters.help_en: The user ID of the user whose comment ban is to be canceled
parameters.name: ban_comment_user
